column1: # Which (preset, ISA) combinations of `make defconfig` have a green preset boot row.
# Read by tools/build/defconfig_menu.py (the menu marks the rest experimental) and checked by its --self-test.
# Columns, tab separated: preset, isa, status (green|experimental), evidence. A green line names its gate row, `preset boot: PRESET ISA` (tools/gate/ci_check.sh),
# and what ran: make defconfig, make build and make qemu reached the selected shell and answered, on a console tools/gate/console_judge.py found clean.
# An experimental line says why the cell fails, or that it was not run; PRESET_BOOT_ALL=1 runs every cell, which is how one earns its green.
